title: Senior Specialist, .NET Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior Associate, AI-Augmented Full-Stack Engineer At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovator, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Associate, AI-Augmented Full-Stack Engineer to join our Wealth . This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: • Embrace Engineering 2.0 practices by actively using AI-augmented development workflows in your day-to-day work, contributing to team velocity and quality improvements • Use AI coding assistants (Windsurf, Claude Code) and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) to accelerate your software delivery, automate routine tasks, and maintain high engineering standards • Contribute to the design and development of scalable solutions that integrate machine learning models, event streaming pipelines, and cloud-native services on Azure and AWS • Support the implementation of data platforms using Snowflake, helping to build and maintain integrations with broader enterprise data ecosystems • Assist in building and maintaining event streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, Azure Event Hubs) to support high-throughput financial data flows • Develop and maintain full-stack features using .NET/C#, Angular, and SQL, writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code • Participate in technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions, actively learning and contributing to discussions on AI-augmented development and cloud patterns • Support team members through peer collaboration and pair programming, helping to foster a culture of continuous learning • Work closely with senior engineers, architects, and data teams to understand and apply best practices for cloud infrastructure and data pipeline design • Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback to improve code quality across the team • Contribute to Agile ceremonies and practices, helping to drive effective and adaptive workflows To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: • Enthusiasm for AI-augmented development, with exposure to or willingness to learn tools such as Windsurf, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) • An understanding of Engineering 2.0 principles and a desire to use AI and intelligent automation to enhance how software is designed, built, and deployed • Familiarity with machine learning concepts and an interest in integrating ML capabilities into applications and data pipelines • Exposure to or willingness to learn Snowflake for data warehousing and analytics • Awareness of event streaming concepts and technologies such as Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or AWS Kinesis • Familiarity with Azure and/or AWS cloud services, with a willingness to deepen your cloud skills across compute, storage, and serverless offerings • Working experience with .NET/C#, Angular, and SQL for building applications and data access layers • Good understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and object-oriented programming • Experience or exposure to Agile delivery practices (ideally Scrum) • Knowledge of TDD, Continuous Integration, and automation practices • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control (e.g., Git) • Ability to analyse designs and code and contribute constructive feedback • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY Linked In Here’s a few of our recent awards: • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 • “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer
- Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans. title: Specialist, Client Service
jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Specialist, Client Service to join our Client Solutions Group. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: The Client Solutions Group (CSG) includes Client Directors, Solution Designers, Client Service and Fixed Income Investment Specialist Teams, working together to provide a range of segregated and pooled fund clients a best in class client experience. This role would require managing multiple sub-teams/ functions who will be responsible to work on a range of functionally aligned tasks in support of the Client Solutions Group. The tasks will include managing client instruction mailbox, production of bespoke client specific reporting for onward delivery to London, periodic KYC reviews, internal reporting to CSG and Sales Force / Share Point client platform maintenance. Collation and production of a suite of internal MIS. Manage the performance of assigned staff and monitoring day to day operations for the Client Solutions Group in India. Contribute to complex/ critical tasks while reviewing and approving tasks where required. title: Senior Director, Global Head of Transfer Agency Transaction Processing, US Head of Transformation and India Head of Investor Solutions
jobDescription:
Senior Director, Global Head of Transfer Agency Transaction Processing, US Head of Transformation and India Head of Investor Solutions We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Senior Director, Operations Group Manager . This role is based out of Pune with accountability across three interconnected areas of the business: Global Head of Transfer Agency Transaction Processing US Head of Transformation India Head of Investor Solutions In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Provide enterprise-level leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight across global transaction processing activities, transformation initiatives for the US business, and investor solutions operations in India. Operate across geographies, influence senior stakeholders, drive change at scale, and deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, control, client experience, and organizational performance. This role is aligned to BNY’s broader objectives of driving operational excellence, enabling growth through transformation, strengthening governance and resilience, and building a scalable global operating model. Global Leadership: Transfer Agency Transaction Processing Lead the end-to-end service delivery and strategic execution of Transfer Agency transaction processing operations, including account maintenance, financial and transfer transactions, rollover processing, correspondence, quality control, and related support functions. Accountable for operational excellence, risk and control management, client service, and transformation initiatives including automation and digital process optimization. Requires deep Transfer Agency operations expertise, strong people leadership, and proven experience driving large-scale process improvement in a regulated environment. title: Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving BNY's Engineering initiatives within the Full-Stack Development job family. This position is crucial in building and enhancing scalable web applications that align with BNY's strategic pillars of innovation and operational excellence. By adhering to BNY's principles of integrity and collaboration, the Full-Stack Engineer ensures that engineering solutions are delivered with precision and efficiency. This role requires a deep understanding of both front-end and back-end technologies, contributing to the seamless integration of complex systems. **PRIMARY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
**
- Lead the design and development of full-stack applications by utilizing industry best practices and cutting-edge technologies.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and implement new features that enhance user experience and system performance.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
- Ensure high quality and performant code through comprehensive testing and debugging processes.
- Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the strategic direction of BNY's technology solutions.
- Stay updated with the latest industry trends and integrate new technologies to advance BNY's engineering capabilities. **EDUCATION/

QUALIFICATIONS:
**
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Advanced degree preferred. **EXPERIENCE:**
- Typically 5-9 years of experience. **SKILLS:**
- Proficiency in multiple programming languages and frameworks, demonstrating expertise in full-stack development.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and strategically.
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, essential for working within diverse teams.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Managed Print Services Technical Infrastructure Lead to join our Production Services – Workplace Technology Services team. This role is located in Chennai, India Role Overview The Technical Infrastructure Lead for Managed Print Services ensures 24×7 availability, security, and performance of BNY’s global print environment. This includes ownership of vulnerability remediation, change management, vendor relationships, and drive modernization initiatives to shift the firm toward more digitized output solutions. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Serve as SME and single point of contact for all print infrastructure related incidents, enabling rapid response and service recovery. Oversee infrastructure changes including product/platform upgrades, performance enhancements and end-of-life management. Identify and track vulnerabilities across the global print environment; drive remediation to meet compliance timelines. Consistently ensure the applications supported are fully compliant to the firm’s technical operational guidelines Maintain and update runbooks, configuration documentation and DR plans in line with Risk & Audit requirements. Manage external print administration vendors, ensuring global service level adherence and high-quality support. Provide technical direction and oversight of vendor-initiated Change Management and DR activities. Design and implement managed print solutions that meet key business requirements. Lead modernization programs: introduce rapid time-to-market capabilities, digitization and reduce reliance on physical printing. Develop short- and long-term technical strategies for the print estate, ensuring the transformational changes are delivered on schedule. Build and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, including acting as the delivery focal point for print-centric projects. Manage risks across Production and Disaster Recovery environments. Complete all compliance and administrative functions accurately and on time. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related discipline (advanced degree preferred) 5–7 years’ experience in infrastructure/application management, including 3–4 years in application ownership Proven track record supporting secure, enterprise-scale print services (financial services a plus) Hands-on experience with industry leading print solutions such as Equitrac, Output Manager, Kofax Auto Store, Red Titan, CA Dispatch, mainframe workflow automation or equivalent solutions Strong understanding of application architecture, end-to-end onboarding (Permit to Design → Build → Operate) Familiarity with monitoring tools (Moog Soft, Splunk), network/server support and their print interactions Excellent problem-solving, product-design and project-management capabilities Outstanding communication and vendor-management skills At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY Linked In Here’s a few of our recent awards: America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. title: Vice President, POM Product Management
jobDescription:
**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Vice President, POM Product Management is a pivotal role within BNY, responsible for driving product strategy and development within the Product Management function. This position aligns with BNY's strategic pillars by fostering innovation and enhancing client service through effective product lifecycle management. As an Individual Contributor, the Vice President plays a crucial role in ensuring that product offerings meet market demands and client expectations, while upholding BNY's principles of integrity, collaboration, and accountability. **PRIMARY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
**
- Lead the development and execution of product strategies by leveraging industry expertise and market insights to enhance product offerings.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful product launches and continuous improvement by demonstrating effective stakeholder management.
- Analyze market trends and client feedback to identify opportunities for product innovation and growth.
- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies by maintaining robust product governance and risk management practices.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry partners to promote product adoption and client satisfaction.
- Provide thought leadership and guidance on product management best practices to support the development of the product management function. **EDUCATION/

**
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred. **EXPERIENCE:**
- Typically 5-8 years of experience. **SKILLS:**
- Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills to drive product innovation and market competitiveness.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
- Proficient in product lifecycle management and governance to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

title: Vice President, Model Risk Management AI, Wealth and Investments
jobDescription:
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Serves as a senior individual contributor within the Risk & Regulatory Compliance function, specializing in Model Risk Management. Applies advanced, multidisciplinary expertise in financial markets, applied mathematics, statistics, econometrics and computer science to identify, measure and manage risks arising from the development, implementation and use of complex models across BNY. Plays a key role in protecting the firm from potential monetary loss, reputational damage and regulatory censure by independently challenging model design, performance and governance. This role advances BNY’s strategic pillars by strengthening the resilience and integrity of core risk and decision‑making frameworks that underpin client offerings and critical services. It reinforces our Principles by fostering a strong risk culture, advocating for transparency in model assumptions and limitations, and promoting accountable decision‑making grounded in rigorous quantitative analysis and sound governance. Operating within the Model Risk Management job family, the role partners closely with model owners, developers, users and risk stakeholders to ensure models are conceptually sound, empirically robust, properly controlled and used within approved risk appetite. Lead independent model validation and ongoing performance review of complex and/or high‑impact models (e.g., pricing, risk, capital, liquidity, credit, market, treasury, stress testing) by applying advanced quantitative methodologies, back‑testing, benchmarking and sensitivity/robustness analysis to assess conceptual soundness and model performance. Identify, quantify and clearly articulate model risk, limitations and weaknesses by critically reviewing model design, assumptions, data, implementation and use, and documenting findings, recommendations and conditions of use in high‑quality validation reports that withstand internal and regulatory scrutiny. Provide effective second‑line challenge to model developers, model owners and model users by engaging in structured technical dialogue, reviewing remediation plans, and evaluating proposed model changes or new models, ensuring alignment with BNY’s model risk management framework, policies and regulatory expectations. Strengthen model governance and control frameworks by contributing to model inventory accuracy, risk tiering, periodic review cycles, and model risk appetite metrics, while supporting the design and implementation of consistent standards, procedures, and templates across the Model Risk Management function. Support regulatory and internal audit engagements related to model risk by preparing clear, evidence‑based materials, responding to technical inquiries, and addressing issues in a timely and transparent manner, thereby reinforcing trust in BNY’s risk management capabilities. Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced team members by reviewing their analytical work, sharing best practices, and promoting a culture of rigorous quantitative discipline, collaboration and continuous improvement within the Model Risk Management community. This role will be focused on Gen AI and Wealth Models. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph D preferred) in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Finance/Financial Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related field. Strong grounding in probability theory, statistical inference, time‑series analysis, and/or numerical methods. Professional certifications in risk management or quantitative finance (e.g., FRM, PRM, CQF) beneficial but not required. Typically 5-8 years of experience Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, including hands‑on experience with model development or validation, and proficiency in relevant programming/analytics tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, SAS, or similar). Deep understanding of financial products, risk measurement concepts and regulatory expectations related to model risk, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear risk narratives and recommendations. Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to provide credible challenge, influence decision‑makers, and produce high‑quality written documentation suitable for senior management, regulators and auditors. title: Senior Vice President, Compliance & Control
jobDescription: In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: The role within the Risk and Compliance Assurance Testing (RCAT) function is responsible for leading an independent technology control testing activities across technology processes, systems, and control environments. The role supports the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of the RCAT testing framework to ensure testing is risk-based, and conducted in accordance with established policies, standards, and methodologies. • Lead and execute independent testing of technology controls, including control design assessment, operating effectiveness testing, evidence review, and documentation of results. • Support the maintenance and enhancement of testing methodologies, procedures, and standards, and recommend improvements to testing processes, controls, and governance practices as needed. • Evaluate technology risks and control environments across key domains, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity and access management, change management, data management, application controls, and resilience. • Identify control deficiencies, thematic issues, and areas of heightened risk, and provide effective challenge on remediation plans, root causes, and control improvements. • Ensure testing workpapers, supporting documentation, and reporting outputs meet quality standards, framework requirements, and established timelines. • Support governance and reporting processes by contributing to internal RCAT meetings, stakeholder forums, and committees, including preparation of testing results, issue themes, and management information. • Partner with technology, business, risk, compliance, and audit stakeholders to promote transparency, coordination, and consistency in control testing and issue management activities. • Provide guidance and support to team members on testing methodology, documentation standards, and technology risk and control expectations. • Engage with Internal Audit and other independent risk and control functions to help streamline coverage, coordinate activities where appropriate, and communicate the status of issues, validation results, and control outcomes. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. • Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, and/or assurance testing roles. •Strong knowledge of technology control frameworks, regulatory expectations, and risk management practices applicable to financial services. • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, provide credible challenge, and communicate complex control and risk matters clearly and effectively. • Proven record of leadership and execution in control testing, technology risk, audit, or related assurance disciplines. • Typically, 10+ years of relevant experience in technology risk, control testing, audit, cybersecurity risk, or related assurance functions. • Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Java, Java Script, C#, C++, Python, and SQL • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to provide credible challenge and partner effectively across technology, risk, compliance, audit, and business teams. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess control effectiveness and synthesize findings into clear, actionable insights. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise reporting for senior management and governance forums. • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and maintain high standards of quality and consistency in a fast-paced environment.

title: Vice President, POM Product Owner
jobDescription:
Vice President, POM Product Owner We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Payments Enablement Platform Data Services Group. This role is located in Pune In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: The Product Owner will lead one of the pods in the Data Services Group, which is one of the groups within the BNY Payments Enablement Enterprise Platform with the mission to be the single authoritative source of payments information to internal and external clients that is simplified, stable, controlled and scalable. Key responsibilities of the Product Owner would be to manage one of the pods within the Data Services group, including Own and manage the product backlog for the pod, ensuring alignment with platform OKRs and strategic priorities. Collaborate with stakeholders across various Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Client Services to define and refine business problems and expected outcomes. Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria. Prioritize backlog items to balance new feature delivery, technical debt, and platform resiliency. Lead sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in partnership with the Scrum Leads and development team. Ensure solution designs align with long-term architecture and platform vision. Monitor and measure pod’s performance, using data to inform decisions and continuous improvement. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree or work experience equivalent 10+ years of overall experience , some of which was in transaction banking, with at least 2 years in a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role. Domain Expertise Payments Data Domain Knowledge Strong grasp of payment processing workflows, including instruction enrichment, validation, and routing logic. Knowledge of transaction classification, foreign exchange determination, and cut-off/value date logic. Awareness of messaging standards (e.g., ISO 20022, SWIFT MT) and regulatory frameworks (e.g., AML, PSD2, FATF). Data Architecture & Platform Familiarity Experience working with data lakes, cloud-based data platforms, and enterprise data warehouses. Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, event-driven architectures, and streaming data pipelines. Ability to collaborate with engineering teams on data modeling, schema design, and data integration. Data Stewardship & Collaboration Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams to define data requirements, prioritize datasets, and resolve data gaps. Experience in data lifecycle management, including ingestion, transformation, and distribution. Comfort with data audit processes, critical control identification, and risk mitigation. Analytics & Decision Support Strong analytical skills to interpret data trends, monitor performance, and inform product decisions. Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and SQL-based analysis. Ability to translate business needs into data-driven user stories and acceptance criteria. Data Governance & Quality Understanding of data governance principles Ability to define and enforce data quality rules, monitor data integrity, and manage remediation workflows. Familiarity with metadata management, data lineage, and data cataloging Product Ownership & Agile Skills Experience as a Product Owner in Agile/Scrum environments, with a solid grasp of Agile principles, ceremonies and backlog prioritization/management. Ability to write clear and actionable user stories, define acceptance criteria, and manage a product backlog. Strong stakeholder management skills — capable of balancing the needs of operations, compliance, IT, and clients. Experience collaborating with development teams, testers, and business SMEs to deliver high-quality solutions. Technical & Analytical Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to work cross-functionally across business and technical teams. Ability to analyze trends and use data to inform product decisions and drive operational efficiency. Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, Excel, and data visualization tools. Soft Skills & Other Qualities Strong communication and documentation skills — able to translate complex payment processes into business and technical requirements. jobDescription:

Works with auditors and clients to ensure statements are accurately produced and verified on a timely basis. Reviews balance sheet, income statement, statement of cash flows and statement of shareholders equity for more complex funds to ensure reported numbers are reconciled. Drafts accounting statements and reports for more complex funds, incorporating fund calculations, for clients to review fund performance. Monitor application health, diagnose issues, and implement performance tuning improvements to ensure reliability at scale. Collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive alignment and support delivery outcomes. Proven experience with Oracle DB, SQL optimization, batch processing, and file-based data pipelines. Proficiency in Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and Microservices architecture; experience with MQ-based messaging systems. Solid understanding of synchronous and asynchronous programming models. Strong track record of writing clean, maintainable code with rigorous code review and configuration management practices. Hands-on experience with Git, Maven, Sonar Qube, and Jira. Familiarity with secure software development practices, observability tooling, and production support processes. Good understanding of Dev Ops principles and CI/CD pipeline implementation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently on complex technical challenges. Effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Vice President, Fund/Client Accounting Manager
jobDescription:
Vice President, Fund/Client Accounting Manager At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President,Fund/Client Accounting Manager to join our NAV Workflow and Control team within Fund and Investor Solutions platform. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Lead the end-to-end fund accounting reconciliation function across multiple client relationships, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent delivery of reconciliations that support NAV accuracy and overall client confidence Own service delivery performance across the function, with accountability for quality, timeliness, escalation management, and operational effectiveness. Provide leadership over the reconciliation control environment, ensuring robust processes are in place to identify, investigate, escalate, and resolve material breaks, aged items, and accounting exceptions. Lead, coach, and develop managers and teams, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Champion the use of data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve reconciliation efficiency, exception management, break analysis, control testing, and operational decision-making. Drive digital transformation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve transparency, strengthen controls, and enhance the client and employee experience. Monitor key performance indicators, operational metrics, and control outcomes to inform decision-making and continuous improvement efforts. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required; MBA preferred 10-12 years of total work experience with at least 3-5 years of management experience preferred Experience in fund accounting reconciliations is preferred At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY Linked In Here’s a few of our recent awards: America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer
- Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans. title: Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving BNY's Engineering initiatives within the Full-Stack Development job family. This position is crucial in building and enhancing scalable web applications that align with BNY's strategic pillars of innovation and operational excellence. By adhering to BNY's principles of integrity and collaboration, the Full-Stack Engineer ensures that engineering solutions are delivered with precision and efficiency. This role requires a deep understanding of both front-end and back-end technologies, contributing to the seamless integration of complex systems. **PRIMARY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
**
- Lead the design and development of full-stack applications by utilizing industry best practices and cutting-edge technologies.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and implement new features that enhance user experience and system performance.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
- Ensure high quality and performant code through comprehensive testing and debugging processes.
- Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the strategic direction of BNY's technology solutions.
- Stay updated with the latest industry trends and integrate new technologies to advance BNY's engineering capabilities. **EDUCATION/

QUALIFICATIONS:
**
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Advanced degree preferred. **EXPERIENCE:**
- Typically 5-9 years of experience. **SKILLS:**
- Proficiency in multiple programming languages and frameworks, demonstrating expertise in full-stack development.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and strategically.
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, essential for working within diverse teams.

title: Vice President, Client Service Management
jobDescription:
Vice President Client Service Management At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President Client Service Management to join the Global Payments & Trade team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Lead strategic client service for India, serving as the senior escalation point and driving executive-level communications, Service Reviews aligned to SLAs and client outcomes. Manage Premium clients based in India to elevate the client experience through a differentiated, consultative approach for this client segment. Conduct regular client visits to strengthen relationships, understand client needs, and act as a trusted advisor in delivering service excellence. Act as the client service point of contact for day-to-day inquiries, ensuring timely responses by adhering to service levels for resolution and providing a quality client experience. Orchestrate cross-functional partnerships and regional coverage across APAC, collaborating with Product, Operations, Technology, Implementation, and Sales to streamline end-to-end client journeys and standardize best practices. Maintain familiarity with industry best practices and market intelligence to offer value-added services such as client digital solutions. Drive and plan service initiatives such as Service Account Plans and Service Reviews. Champion digital enablement and process transformation across transaction banking, including FX, Payments, Trade Finance, and Cash Management, to increase STP, reduce defects, and improve turnaround times. Support multiple geographies, when required, and client accounts across APAC. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Minimum 15 years of relevant product/financial experience in banking or client service. Fluent in business Hindi, written and conversational. Fluency in another Asian language is an added advantage to cover other client segments. Foundation in transaction banking product knowledge, including FX, Payments, Trade Finance, Cash Management, and related areas. Excellent interpersonal skills and a positive attitude. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Consultancy or data analytics skills are an added advantage for managing transformation initiatives. Vice President, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis to join our BNY Institute – BNY’s macro strategy insights platform team. This role is located in Pune In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: We are building out the capabilities of BNY Institute to transform complex data into compelling stories for internal strategists and external clients. Help architect and deliver interactive chart packs, exploratory dashboards, and—over time—AI-augmented “smart” visualizations that helps our data tell a story for clients. Platform Build-out Design a scalable charting framework with reusable templates. Integrate with data APIs and Snowflake/S3 for real-time refreshes and cache management. Establish CI/CD pipelines for front-end deployments. Chart Pack Development Produce automated macro & flow “packs” that update with latest data drops. Implement advanced interactivity: drill-downs, scenario sliders, annotation layers. Optimize performance for large time-series and high-frequency charts.for data cleansing, feature engineering, and model integration. Smart Visualization R&D Prototype NLP-driven chart search, automated chart recommendations, and anomaly-surfacing visuals. Collaborate with AI engineers to embed models into UX seamlessly. UX
- Visualize large data sets (structured/unstructured) Drive best practices in data-driven storytelling; host demos and training sessions. Gather feedback from research, sales, and marketing to iterate quickly. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Proficiency in SQL, data modeling, and complex data transformation Advanced programming skills in Python and/or Java Script for building customized analytics and visualization solutions. Experience with visualization and analytics libraries such as Plotly, Matplotlib, Pandas, D3.js, or similar tools Strong knowledge of UX/UI principles, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and decision-driven design Ability to simplify complex datasets into clear, actionable, and business-focused insights Exposure to AI/Generative AI, and NLP tools to accelerate visualization analytics, automate data preparation, and enhance insight generation and end user experience. Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required; bachelor’s degree is preferred. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. title: Vice President, Production Services Application Support

Lead complex technical triage across application, database, middleware, messaging, batch, and infrastructure layers to restore service quickly and effectively. Support batch scheduling, recovery, and operational validations using Control-M and approved support procedures. Champion automation using Ansible and UNIX/Linux scripting to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and strengthen operational controls. Support MQ and Kafka platforms to ensure stable integration and operational continuity. Maintain support documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, escalation guides, and recovery procedures. Participate in production readiness reviews, resiliency testing, disaster recovery exercises, and failover validations. Use Service Now for incident, problem, change, service request, and follow-up tracking. Collaborate with global teams and deliver clear, confident updates during incidents, bridge calls, and leadership communications. Leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to elevate documentation, analysis, reporting, knowledge management, and team productivity. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s or higher degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 10+ years of proven experience in production support, application support, or technology operations. Demonstrated success supporting enterprise-scale, mission-critical applications in complex production environments. Knowledge of payments domain flows, transaction processing, and production issue analysis. Hands-on Oracle SQL experience for querying, troubleshooting, data validation, and issue investigation. Strong UNIX/Linux skills, including log analysis, file system checks, process monitoring, and command-line troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Ansible for automation and operational task execution. Knowledge of App Engine and application runtime support. Experience with Git Lab and CI/CD pipelines for deployment, release, and validation activities. Experience with Control-M or similar enterprise batch scheduling tools. Experience with Splunk, Grafana/Optics, App Dynamics, Moogsoft, and related observability platforms. Experience using Service Now for ITSM, including incident, problem, change, and service request management. Proficiency in messaging technologies such as MQ and Kafka. Exposure to AI-enabled productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot. Strong understanding of incident, problem, and change management, production readiness, and operational risk controls. Ability to analyze logs, alerts, batch failures, messaging issues, transaction breaks, infrastructure events, and application errors to identify root cause and remediation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear updates for technology, operations, business, and leadership stakeholders. Ability to stay composed under pressure, take ownership during critical incidents, and drive issues to closure with urgency and accountability.

title: Vice President, Corporate Operational Risk
jobDescription: We are seeking a team member to lead the design and delivery of Operational Risk's data and analytics ecosystem by combining deep data engineering expertise with risk, governance, and reporting knowledge to enable data-driven risk intelligence across the organization. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Serve as the Lead Data Engineer and subject matter expert for Operational Risk Reporting & Analytics, providing strategic data leadership and technical direction. Design and manage secure, scalable, and resilient data architectures that support Operational Risk reporting, analytics, governance, and regulatory requirements. Build and optimize end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and modern data engineering frameworks to automate ingestion and integration of data from multiple internal and external sources. Lead advanced data transformation and modeling using dbt and Snowflake, creating trusted, high-quality datasets that support enterprise risk reporting and analytics. Develop and enhance the Operational Risk Data Warehouse (NFR Data Warehouse) to establish a centralized and governed source of risk data. Partner with Operational Risk, Audit, Technology, and Business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data and analytics solutions. Deliver business intelligence, reporting, dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities that provide actionable risk insights to management, committees, and regulatory stakeholders. Establish and maintain robust data governance, quality, lineage, stewardship, and control frameworks to ensure data integrity, transparency, and compliance. Drive Agile delivery, automation, innovation, and continuous improvement , leveraging modern engineering practices, AI-enabled solutions, CI/CD pipelines, and emerging technologies. Transform operational risk data into proactive risk intelligence that supports risk identification, trend analysis, decision-making, and broader Operational Risk Management objectives. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ETL/ELT development, and Data Analytics along with 5+ years of domain experience Technical Stack Mastery: Snowflake: Deep understanding of cloud data warehouse architecture, virtual warehouses, performance tuning, and role-based access control. Python: Advanced programming skills for data manipulation, API integration, and automation. dbt: Proven track record of using dbt for managing staging/mart layers, DAGs, and automated testing in a production environment. SQL: Expert-level ability to write complex, performant queries and analytical functions. Streamlit: Hands-on experience building lightweight, interactive Python UI applications. Power BI: Hands-on experience on building basic reports and dashboards Core Concepts: Strong foundational knowledge of data warehouse dimensional modeling , data analytics, and robust data governance principles (data quality, stewardship, and compliance). Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working in Risk Management, specifically Non-Financial Operational Risk, Compliance, or Audit workflows is highly preferred. Soft Skills: Exceptional cognitive and problem-solving skills, leadership skill, meticulous attention to detail, and a demonstrated eagerness to learn and adopt emerging technologies. Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical teams and business leadership. Additional Tools: Experience with AWS, Azure products and BI tools is a strong plus.

title: Senior Vice President, Corporate Operational Risk
jobDescription:
We are seeking a senior leader to lead and enhance Operational Risk monitoring and reporting capabilities across the firm's Risk Appetite Statement (RAS), Operational Risk Metrics, Issue Management, and Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) programs to deliver proactive, data-driven risk oversight and actionable management insights In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Lead the enhancement and oversight of the firm's Risk Appetite Statement, Operational Risk Metrics, Issue Management, and RCSA programs . Build and strengthen Operational Risk monitoring capabilities that provide timely, meaningful, and actionable risk insights to senior management and governance committees. Partner with global teams on independent second-line review and challenge of RCSA assessments, control effectiveness evaluations, residual risk ratings, and remediation plans Enhance the Risk Appetite Statement and Operational Risk Metrics program by ensuring metrics are relevant, risk-focused, forward-looking, and aligned to the firm's operational risk profile. Identify emerging risks, recurring themes, control weaknesses, and risk concentrations through integrated analysis of RCSA, Issues, Operational Risk Events, Metrics, Audit, and Compliance data. Develop executive-level reporting and committee materials that translate risk data into clear business insights and management actions. Build and lead a high-performing India-based Operational Risk Framework team supporting global oversight activities. Drive continuous improvement through automation, enhanced reporting, data-driven monitoring, and modernization of Operational Risk framework activities. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Risk Management, Economics, Accounting, Law, Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 12+ years of experience in Operational Risk, Non-Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk Management, Controls, or Risk Governance , preferably within financial services. Expertise in: Risk Appetite Statements and threshold governance Operational Risk Metrics and Key Risk Indicators Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) Issue Management and remediation governance Operational Risk Events Root cause analysis and control effectiveness assessments Operational Risk reporting and committee governance Demonstrated ability to provide independent review and challenge, exercise sound risk judgment, and influence senior stakeholders. Strong understanding of Operational Risk frameworks, regulatory expectations, operational resilience, and non-financial risk management. Experience developing and enhancing risk monitoring, governance reporting, metrics, dashboards, and thematic analysis capabilities. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret risk data, identify trends, assess emerging risks, and translate analysis into actionable insights. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to present complex risk issues to senior management and governance forums. Proven leadership experience building teams, developing talent, and driving strategic Operational Risk initiatives. title: Senior Vice President, Treasury and ALM
jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Treasury and ALM to join our Corporate Treasury team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Independently provides expertise to the modeling and forecasting related to controlling the risks associated with assets, liabilities, and Interest Rate Risk (IRR) management. Identifies opportunities to enhance Interest Rate Risk analytics. Develops policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and Corporate guidance related to IRR including underlying assumptions and limitations to risk management framework. Monitors compliance to internal and regulatory balance sheet metrics for assigned legal entities/ region and escalates any issues to senior management. Collects financial data, validates, and runs IRR models/analyses. Ensures models are functioning as expected, troubleshoots and reports on unexpected/undesired results. Assess and monitors risks inherent in new or changing Bank products and implements adjustments to technical processes as needed. Provides technical guidance to less experienced team members on complex issues. Identifies opportunities to enhance Interest Rate Risk measurement and reporting. Monitors industry developments and applies best practices to establish policies and procedures that support the interest rate risk strategies for the assigned entity(ies) and balance regulatory requirements. Establishes team policies and procedures related to all technical activities such as documentation requirements, underlying assumptions, data limitations, etc. Develops reports and briefings for senior management, identifying risks and recommending proposed solutions. Ensures recommendations align to the corporate Treasury strategies and the strategies of the assigned entity(ies). Monitors the regulatory environment, conducts applicable research and makes recommendations for responding to emerging/changing regulatory requirements affecting Interest Rate Risk. Conducts special projects and ad-hoc analyses/reporting as requested. May serve as a project lead, engaging peers across the Bank and providing task oversight. Builds and cultivates relationships with internal peers in Treasury, Finance and Risk organization. Ensure that data within the IRR process is suitable for its intended purpose. Work collaboratively with Enterprise Teams to maintain data quality rules and support the integration of new data attributes. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Degree in math, engineering, statistics, computational finance or economics preferred. MBA, CFA, FRM, CA preferred 10-15 years of total work experience preferred. Experience with Quantitative Risk Management (QRM) or similar IRR platform Experience with interest rate risk management and/or asset-liability management within large complex financial organizations preferred. Continuously learns and pragmatically applies new tools/techniques to improve outcomes. Proficiency in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, SQL, PL/SQL. Strong interest in enterprise data and working knowledge of RDBMS (Oracle or equivalent). Knowledge of Micro-Services Architecture and scalable high resiliency systems Familiar with Agile development methodologies Strong full stack development experience with all latest technologies Familiar with CICD, Maven, JIRA, GIT, UNIT Testing Prompt engineering for code/tests with verification steps; avoid blind acceptance of generated code. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Custody, Trustee & Depositary Centre of Excellence team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Collaborate with the Business, SMEs, and End Users to gather and develop story level requirements in JIRA that allows the Development Team to deliver consistent level of high-quality code. Participate in all agile/sprint activities (planning, backlog refinement, retrospective, standups, and design). Create and maintain story level functional, non-functional requirements and Acceptance Criteria in JIRA (excluding technical tasks). Write and elaborate stories to align with Product definition of “Ready for Development.” Validate stories with cross functional stakeholders, including Business, SMEs, and End Users to gather requirements and desired outcomes. Review test cases with testers to ensure test results meet expected outcomes as defined in acceptance criteria. Review testing failures to identify potential missed/new requirements or defects. Prepare and circulate release notes as part of operational readiness. Support other Ops readiness activities as required. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Agile methodology expertise. Project Management experience using JIRA & Confluence. Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Excel & Power Point. Business Analytics skills using Microsoft Power BI & Tableau. Understanding of Investment Banking: Subsidiaries, CSDs and different organizations contributing to investment banking business. Knowledge of Asset Servicing business. Custody Product Knowledge, specifically: • Corporate Action and Income product from Custody business perspective • Proxy product from Custody business perspective • Class Action product from Custody business perspective Bachelor’s or post graduate degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience in business management or related field. 10+ years of total work experience in Project / Product delivery (Agile delivery preferred). As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Custody, Trustee & Depositary Centre of Excellence team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Collaborate with the Business, SMEs, and End Users to gather and develop story level requirements in JIRA that allows the Development Team to deliver consistent level of high-quality code. Participate in all agile/sprint activities (planning, backlog refinement, retrospective, standups, and design). Create and maintain story level functional, non-functional requirements and Acceptance Criteria in JIRA (excluding technical tasks). Write and elaborate stories to align with Product definition of “Ready for Development.” Validate stories with cross functional stakeholders, including Business, SMEs, and End Users to gather requirements and desired outcomes. Review test cases with testers to ensure test results meet expected outcomes as defined in acceptance criteria. Review testing failures to identify potential missed/new requirements or defects. Prepare and circulate release notes as part of operational readiness. Support other Ops readiness activities as required. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Agile methodology expertise. Project Management experience using JIRA & Confluence. Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Excel & Power Point. Business Analytics skills using Microsoft Power BI & Tableau. Understanding of Investment Banking: Subsidiaries, CSDs and different organizations contributing to investment banking business. Knowledge of Asset Servicing business. Custody Product Knowledge, specifically: • Corporate Action and Income product from Custody business perspective • Proxy product from Custody business perspective • Class Action product from Custody business perspective Bachelor’s or post graduate degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience in business management or related field. 10+ years of total work experience in Project / Product delivery (Agile delivery preferred). No direct reports, provides guidance to less experienced colleagues. Leads projects and allocates work accordingly. Relevant market / industry certifications – e.g., AAC, CCBA, CBAP. At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY Linked In Here’s a few of our recent awards: America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer
- Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans. materially enhance platform capability, control, scalability, and long-term value. • Provide senior product leadership within the Data Product function, acting as a visible and influential leader across Product Owners and partner teams to align priorities, sequencing, and delivery outcomes across the broader transformation agenda. • Drive the data product vision through hands-on product ownership, taking accountability for requirements definition, prioritization, and outcome-focused delivery across one or more Scrum teams. • Serve as a trusted subject matter expert in Custody and related domains like Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Custody, Corporate Actions, offering insight, challenge, and decision support to Product, Technology, and Operations stakeholders as complex design, migration, and delivery trade-offs are evaluated. • Translate strategic objectives into clear, executable delivery plans by shaping backlog priorities, managing cross-team dependencies, and ensuring delivery remains aligned and coherent as scope and complexity evolve. • Establish strong data foundations across the product area by defining data requirements, influencing priorities, and aligning teams to shared data models, quality standards, and clearly articulated migration outcomes. • Lead delivery beyond build, ensuring migration, adoption, and operational readiness are embedded into the product lifecycle so that new capabilities are successfully implemented into day-to-day operations. • Build strong relationships across a broad stakeholder group, driving engagement, alignment, and decision-making across senior business, operations, product, and technology partners. • Lead through influence and credibility, proactively navigating ambiguity, identifying delivery risks early, and helping teams resolve complex challenges across a large and evolving transformation environment. • Provide leadership to teams and direct reports where applicable, while coaching and developing Product Owners and wider team members through challenge, support, and example. • Role model modern, inclusive product leadership, fostering collaboration, shared accountability, and high-performance ways of working during a period of significant organisational and platform change. • Bring strong energy and commitment to transformation, with a passion for solving complex problems, improving platforms at scale, and delivering tangible outcomes into production. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, Compliance Monitoring and Surveillance to join our BNY Investments team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Perform surveillance testing over assigned areas and trading desks including best execution, fair allocation, cross trading, conflicts of interest, recordkeeping, short selling and conduct related matters. Assist in the execution of monitoring reviews to ensure they are completed in a timely manner and focused on key risks within a regulatory topic, with tests suitably designed to identify key issues. Support the E-comms and Voice surveillance programme across BNY Investments in the investigation of escalations which may result in policy breaches, including subsequent communications and logging. Ensure actions arising from surveillance tests or monitoring reviews are well defined, proportionate to the risk they seek to mitigate, and communicated in a thoughtful risk-adjusted manner appropriate for the audience; retain oversight and work with the business to ensure timely completion as designed. Constantly consider and, where possible, provide innovative ideas to improve the monitoring and surveillance programmes. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; education requirement not specified in the provided context. Minimum of 2 years of experience in Compliance Monitoring/Surveillance or Internal Auditing in an Asset Management firm or Bank. Strong analytical skills with the ability to think logically, use initiative, and systematically resolve problems. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Power Point, and Excel, with the ability to build reports to support the extraction and analysis of data sets. title: Senior Specialist, Market and Liquidity Risk
jobDescription:
Senior Specialist, Market and Liquidity Risk At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, Market and Liquidity Risk Support to join our Investments Risk team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: • Generate, combine, reconcile, and tailor risk and performance attribution reports across various systems. • Identify and monitor key risk and performance indicators and metrics, and assess the effectiveness of risk mitigation strategies and controls. • Conduct regular reviews of investment risk guidelines, benchmark suitability, risk proxy validity, and deviations from established risk and investment parameters. • Develop, refine, and automate comprehensive end-to-end processes for performance and risk management reporting and monitoring. • Coordinate with corporate Risk functions to ensure consistency in risk reporting and policies and procedures. • Assist in the development of a central database for client and portfolio data, such as AUM/AUA by client, investment types, objectives, and a cross-mapping of investment identifiers across multiple systems. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: • MBA Finance or equivalent • FRM or CFA designation is desirable • Must have hands-on working knowledge of Aladdin or Morningstar and Bloomberg • 2-6 years of relevant work experience • Ability to learn quickly and a high degree of problem-solving skills • Ability to work in a high-pressure environment • Comfortable working in evening shifts At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY Linked In Here’s a few of our recent awards: America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. title: Specialist, Credit Services II
jobDescription:
Specialist, Credit Services II We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Specialist, Credit Services II to join our First Line Credit
- Markets team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: • Credit Analysis & Underwriting: Perform credit analysis across industries, sectors, and counterparties; support underwriting of credit transactions and ongoing management of credit relationships under guidance. • Counterparty & Market Credit Risk: Assist with counterparty credit risk assessments, including borrower re-ratings, transaction reviews, and support for Market Risk and Intraday Credit Risk activities. • Portfolio Performance Monitoring: Conduct portfolio performance assessments through analysis of NAV data, financial statements, and periodic financial reports to identify trends and emerging risks. • Credit Administration & Governance: Support credit reviews and submissions, preparation of credit proposals and financial spreads, and audit proposals to ensure compliance with internal credit policies and approval standards. • Reporting & Operational Support: Assist with ad hoc and standard credit risk reporting, data quality checks, and operational credit risk activities across Credit Analysis, Portfolio Management, Country Risk, or Credit Administration teams. • Technical, Automation & Product Exposure: Apply SQL, Python, and Excel-based automation to improve credit processes and reporting; gain exposure to Prime Brokerage, Repo, and other client-facing market risk products while supporting process efficiency initiatives. jobDescription: We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Data Scientist to join our Markets team. This role is located in Pune. Partner with cross-functional teams to design and implement data-driven solutions aligned to organizational priorities and business objectives. Manage and enhance large datasets while ensuring strong data integrity, accuracy, and adherence to data management and governance best practices. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior Vice President, Fullstack Engineer At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Fullstack Engineer to join our Integrated Middle Office Solutions team. This role is located in Pune In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Leading and developing the Pune-based IBOR Engineering team, including approximately 4–5 direct reports. Driving engineering delivery for the IBOR Strategic Reengineering roadmap in support of the Middle Office 2027 North Star target architecture. Leading modernization efforts to replace legacy Ruby services with Java-based strategic platforms and solutions. Providing strong technical leadership across architecture, design, software quality, and execution. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Significant experience leading engineering teams in complex enterprise technology environments. Strong technical expertise in Java engineering, distributed systems, and platform modernization. Experience delivering large-scale reengineering, modernization, or transformation initiatives. Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing engineering teams and developing talent. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

jobDescription:
Vice President, Client Processing Manager At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Client Processing Manager to join our Global Transfer Agency team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Own the end-to-end Trade processing until settlement, including task allocation, controls, quality, and risk management Act as the primary point of contact for process queries, client escalations, and senior stakeholder communication Build strong, trusted client relationships and ensure consistent, accurate service delivery Ensure full compliance with BNY policies and all regulatory daily, weekly, monthly, and annual requirements, including timely escalation of control breaches Lead and manage the team, including workload planning, performance management, coaching, training, and all related people processes Monitor team process knowledge and quality, providing regular feedback and driving continuous improvement Identify process risks and errors, ensure root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions Drive the Digital and AI agenda by identifying automation opportunities and embedding digital solutions to deliver higher STP, increased efficiency, and reduced operational risk Lead and coordinate business and change initiatives impacting day to-day operations To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or related field required. Advanced degree or professional certifications in finance or business administration preferred. Typically 8+ years of experience in Transfer Agency or related field within financial services. Good experience of Trade processing, reconciliation, client service and people management required. Strong leadership and collaboration skills across diverse teams, with excellent interpersonal skills for client interactions. Experience in holding teams responsible to department KRI’s and undertaking annual performance reviews with teams. Demonstrable interest in continuous learning and delivery of process improvements, including the use of digital tools and AI. title: Vice President, Compliance & Control
jobDescription:
VPR Grade – Financial Crime SME/ Trainer We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Lead Transaction Monitoring Team Trainer
- Vice President (individual contributor) to join our FCC Transaction Monitoring team . This role is based in Chennai or Pune (Hybrid). In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Provide the Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”), terrorist financing, and other Financial Crimes-related training to the India-based Level 1 transaction monitoring investigations team. Identify and assess training needs of the transaction monitoring team through gap analysis; quality analysis; rework trends; Quality Assurance, Internal Audit and regulatory findings; and consultation with managers and senior management. Develop, design and/or update in-person, virtual, and online training including creating all content and materials to address training needs. Establish training to address all levels of experience including new employees and tenured investigators. Consult with Managers on a periodic basis to evaluate Team performance and ensure that training is meeting business needs and improving performance. Focus training on high-priority business lines such as wealth management, treasury services, and broker/dealer services. Integrate BNY systems and investigation workflow into training. Prepares internal reports for management on daily/weekly work status, training information and all other related MI. Maintains training records of all in-house training conducted for future purposes. Apply skills and expertise to identifying and compiling the right set of process recommendations to management to address specific workflow or investigation enhancements. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience) required 5+ years of AML Transaction Monitoring or financial crimes compliance experience, including hands-on investigations and narrative writing. 3+ years in training, Learning & Development, coaching, or team leadership roles within AML or related risk functions. Strong knowledge of anti-money laundering, terrorist financing and export control evasion risks and typologies. Deep expertise in correspondent banking, private wealth management and securities. Strong understanding of the United States, UK, and/or European AML regulatory requirements and expectations. Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to convey complex information clearly to diverse audiences Strong understanding of compliance policies; consistently processes tasks in accordance with established procedures and controls Familiarity with AML model changes, alerting logic, workflow tooling, and change management processes.
