As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Full Stack Developer to join our platform group. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Drive the design, development, and delivery of critical product features across multiple domains, focusing on reliability, performance, security, and regulatory compliance. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate architectural vision and product roadmaps into scalable, high-quality software solutions. Lead platform modernization, scaling, and re-architecture initiatives that enable transformational product improvements. Provide expert-level hands-on development using Java (Spring Boot), Python, and modern front-end frameworks such as Angular and React Js. Directly engage in coding and technical problem-solving to advance modernization efforts and platform scalability. Influence technical direction and architectural decisions through deep technical expertise and practical implementation. Champion engineering best practices, including reactive/non-blocking programming and contract-first API design, while continuously evaluating emerging technologies for potential integration. Act as a technical mentor by sharing knowledge and elevating the skills of peers through collaboration and leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence. Contribute thought leadership to shape the team’s engineering standards and technical vision. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus. 14+ years of experience in software engineering with deep expertise in full‑stack development and proficiency in architecture. Strong expertise in Java, Python, SQL, Oracle, Snowflake, Angular, and React Js. Experience with cloud platforms, containers, and microservices architecture. Experience with emerging technologies, including Gen AI integration. Experience with implementation of Machine Learning models for enterprise applications. Fluency in performance, scalability, resiliency, and security tradeoffs. Proven track record delivering large‑scale, high‑impact products in complex environments. title: Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: As Oracle SQL / PLSQL expert, Understand existing processes, task schedules and its implication to Sec Lending business Build, design, enhance SQL queries as part of application upgrades Bug Fixes
- Fix SQL queries and / or data pipelines via documented SDLC process. Provide tactical and strategic fixes as needed Operate mission-critical systems and deliver day-to-day enhancements across Sec Lending Agency and Principal business Identify opportunities to improve processes, optimize Oracle queries & provide technical oversight Document current processes, job schedules and proactively understand its usage in the context of Securities Lending business Design and develop core components in Java or Python Work closely with business analysts, PO and analyze requirements Create and implement system testing procedures Collaborate and work with other teams in a platform operating model Analyze and support vendor software Stakeholder management Project Prioritization Delivery & Maintenance for the applications within Equities domain Provide second level support Usage of AI tools like Gitlab/Windsurf/ Co-Pilot Develop Unit Test Cases with a view to integration into CI/CD pipeline To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor's or higher degree in computer science/ engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required 10+ years of experience in software development required Strong proficiency & commercial development with Oracle, SQL and Git (only familiarity is NOT sufficient) Proficiency with Data Standards & Data Modelling Proficiency with text-based formats like YML & JSON Core Java or Python commercial development experience (only familiarity is NOT sufficient) Familiarity with testing patterns and dev ops Familiarity with cloud / containerization Comfortable in Windows and Linux environments Good to have
- Investment banking experience around Securities Lending, Fixed Income Products Experience in the securities or financial services industry with focus on Fixed Income Products – Treasuries, Corporate Bonds, Agencies, Commercial Paper, Mortgages. Previous experience designing and implementing new systems and features independently Developed market data feeds and feeds to downstream systems Understanding of trade life cycle events for fixed income Understanding of regulatory landscape from a developer perspective At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY Linked In Here’s a few of our recent awards: America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer
- Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer to join our ENTERPRISE RISK TECH RISK ENGINEERING team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack applications using Java-based backend technologies and modern frontend frameworks. Build and maintain scalable RESTful APIs, microservices, and web applications. Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Drive best practices in software design, coding standards, testing, security, and performance optimization. Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technology strategy and engineering roadmaps. Troubleshoot production issues and implement sustainable fixes and improvements. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team capability building. Support CI/CD implementation, automated testing, and Dev Ops practices. Ensure applications meet reliability, availability, and compliance standards. Work within Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and delivery. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience in full-stack application development. Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, and integration patterns. Experience with relational and/or No SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, Postgre SQL, or Mongo DB. Familiarity with version control systems like Git. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build tools, and deployment automation. Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), design patterns, and secure coding practices. Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, MQ, or Rabbit MQ. jobDescription:
SRE, Senior Specialist, Production Services Application Support At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Production Services Infrastructure Engineer to join our team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: As a SRE Automation Analyst, will be responsible to SRE Automation Analyst to support the expansion of Site Reliability Engineering through hands-on delivery of automation, CI/CD, and platform operations. The analyst will contribute to backend automation and Tool development in Python and/or Java (with exposure to Go), support Infrastructure‑as‑Code and containerized workloads (Kubernetes/Docker), and versed in adopting standardized tooling such as Terraform, Ansible, and Argo CD. This role will work alongside senior SRE and platform leaders to implement Tool/infrastructure automation, and cloud‑native services across on‑prem/private cloud. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor's or higher degree in computer science/ engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required Partnering with engineering, product, and platform teams, the role will translate well‑defined requirements into repeatable automation, follow established Dev Ops and reliability practices, and help document runbooks, SLOs, and operational processes. Strong understanding of Capacity planning/management for IT infrastructure (Memory, CPU and Storage) Ideal candidates bring strong foundational skills in Linux, scripting, cloud platforms, and distributed systems concepts, with hands-on exposure to CI/CD and Kubernetes. This role is designed to grow technical depth and reliability expertise while delivering incremental improvements in deployment consistency, observability, and mean‑time‑to‑recovery under the mentorship of senior staff. Strong proficiency with Azure and on‑prem private cloud Strong full-stack development experience, with hands-on expertise in Python (with exposure to Go), support Infrastructure‑as‑Code and containerized workloads (Kubernetes/Docker) Assist in adopting standardized tooling such as Terraform, Ansible, and Argo CD. Hands-on experience with Ansible and Kubernetes in enterprise or production environments. Strong foundation in Linux/Unix systems administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and infrastructure concepts. Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring and observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, App Dynamics, and Splunk Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills in complex distributed or production environments. title: Senior Specialist, Production Services Application Support Analyst
jobDescription:
Senior Specialist, Production Services Application Support Analyst At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #Life At BNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. We are seeking a Senior Specialist, Production Services Application Support Analyst (L1/L2) to join our Production Services Engineering team in Pune. Role Overview This role is responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of production applications by providing Level 1 and Level 2 support. The analyst will play a critical role in incident management, monitoring, issue resolution, and maintaining operational excellence across a growing portfolio of applications. Production Support & Incident Management • Provide L1/L2 support for production systems, ensuring timely triage and resolution of incidents • Monitor application health and proactively identify risks using monitoring tools • Lead incident response, including impact assessment, troubleshooting, and resolution coordination • Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, and incident management processes Monitoring & Operational Excellence • Perform continuous monitoring of applications, infrastructure, and batch processes • Handle alert management and escalation as required • Maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles • Support 24x7 operations with on-call rotation Automation & Continuous Improvement • Identify repetitive manual activities and convert them into automation solutions. • Develop scripts using: • Shell / Python / SQL automation • Automate routine activities such as: • MQ queue monitoring and alerts • Oracle health checks • Batch job validation and restart • Log parsing and alert generation • Contribute to building self-healing and auto-remediation solutions. Root Cause Analysis & Problem Management • Conduct RCA for major incidents and recurring issues • Partner with development and infrastructure teams to implement permanent fixes • Track and reduce incident volume through continuous improvement Change & Release Support • Support production releases, deployments, and environment validations • Validate post-deployment stability and coordinate rollback if needed • Ensure adherence to change management and release governance processes Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication • Act as the first point of contact for production issues • Communicate effectively with business stakeholders, development teams, and vendors • Provide regular updates during incidents and outages To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) • 4–8 years of experience in application production support (L1/L2) • Strong understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes • Experience supporting mission-critical, high-availability systems Technical Skills • Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., App Dynamics, Splunk, Dynatrace, etc.) • Knowledge of UNIX/Linux and Windows environments • Familiarity with databases (SQL/Oracle) • Understanding of batch processing and scheduling tools • Experience with messaging systems (MQ/Kafka) is a plus • Basic scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, etc.) preferred Preferred Skills • Experience in financial services or capital markets domain • Understanding of application architecture and distributed systems • Familiarity with ITIL practices and service management frameworks • Exposure to cloud platforms and Dev Ops practices Key Competencies • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced production environment • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills • Proactive mindset with focus on operational stability and continuous improvement In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: • Ensuring stable and reliable production systems • Reducing operational and compliance risks • Supporting scalable growth of the application portfolio Our Benefits and Rewards: BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President POM Product Owner to join our Wealth Services team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Responsible for end-to-end delivery of products. Collaborates with Product Manager, Operations, Engineering, Design and Architects to drive products and features from concept to launch in a fast-paced environment. Turns client and data insights into products with actionable outcomes to the ultimate customer. Partners with stakeholders and customers across the organization to inform the product vision, strategy, features, and prioritization. Assist product manager in developing, owning and executing on product roadmap. Works with design and user research to define the user experience, support, and monitoring for customers. Works in an Agile environment and continuously reviews the business needs, refines priorities, outlines milestones and deliverables, and identifies opportunities and risks. Works with cross-functional teams and various stakeholders, including analytics, design/user experience, engineering, and user enablement. Translates product roadmap features into well-defined product requirements including features, user stories, and acceptance test criteria. Prioritizes and maintains the sprint backlog for assigned products, balancing the requirements of stakeholders. Leads the product functional design process based on an intimate knowledge of the users and technology. Develops and maintains appropriate tracking and reporting of product performance post-launch to evaluate future investment. Adherence to the processes and creation of artifacts required for securing approval of multiple toll gates for releasing code to production. Participate and contribute in building and strengthening of Product Owner Center of excellence. Product Owner Skills: Balance of technical knowledge and business acumen. Customer first mind set. Proactive, self-starter with excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment. High degree of organization, individual initiative, and personal accountability. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: 6-10 years of direct product management experience in end user applications in Wealth Management, Broker Dealer, Custody, or Consumer Facing fintech space Alternatively, MBA with 3+ years’ experience in general management consulting firms (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG, Strategy&, Deloitte) within their Financial Services practice or their digital arms focused on Financial Services clients Master’s degree in engineering, business from Tier 1 schools Proven track record of delivering products with a customer-first mindset. Established background in launching software or services in partnership with engineering teams and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development, understanding of Agile principles. title: Senior Vice President, Infrastructure Solution Engineer
jobDescription:
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Java/Spring and Python, with strong focus on reliability, performance, and seamless integration across distributed application components and enterprise platforms. Build modern engineering solutions across the full software lifecycle, including frontend development where needed, automated testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and translating business and technical requirements into high-quality, maintainable code. Design, build, and maintain observability integrations and custom monitoring solutions across enterprise platforms such as App Dynamics, Dynatrace, Thousand Eyes, Solar Winds, Prometheus/Grafana, Moogsoft, and Splunk, including instrumentation with Open Telemetry and development of telemetry pipelines, health checks, synthetic monitoring, and self-healing automation to strengthen operational visibility and service resilience. Develop and support observability and infrastructure integration capabilities, including integrations with enterprise monitoring, telemetry, and ITSM platforms, as well as custom health checks, automation, and telemetry solutions to improve operational insight and resilience. Drive strong software quality, security, and engineering standards through test-driven approaches, comprehensive automated test coverage, secure software development practices, peer review, vulnerability scanning, and adherence to coding and architectural standards. Build and maintain containerized delivery and deployment pipelines using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD platforms, enabling automated, secure, and efficient promotion of code through development and production environments. Leverage modern AI-assisted engineering tools and emerging AI capabilities to accelerate development, improve productivity, and enhance solutions, while collaborating effectively with product owners, architects, Dev Ops, QA, and cross-functional teams to deliver business value. requirements into high-quality, maintainable code.

Bachelor's degree in business management or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 3-5 years product experience, 5-10 years of financial services experience requirements, and working closely with development team to ensure the successful delivery of the product.

title: Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner
jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner to join our Global Clearing team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Defining and prioritizing product backlog, collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements, and working closely with development team to ensure the successful delivery of the product. Managing the product backlog and near-term roadmap ensuring that it is properly refined, prioritized and groomed. Owning user stories, refinement process and Stakeholder Management (ongoing collaboration and updates) Negotiating the implementation of current work, make the right trade-off decisions to launch products in a high-quality manner. Escalating to management as necessary. Identifying and triaging issues with specific features, whilst understanding how multiple features are interrelated. Completing complex data analysis including anomaly detection and commonality identification via AI, SQL, Excel, BI and other tools. Defining proper measurement and instrumentation for a product to analyze results post-release/launch. Partnering with manager to make recommendations on the right next steps for the feature. Assessing the quality of existing UX to make recommendations on how to improve user experience. Participating in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups. Implementing data visualization and dashboard development for actionable business use, including translating stakeholder questions into clear metrics, KPIs, and insights that help users identify trends, monitor performance, surface risks, and make informed decisions. Partnering with scrum masters, developers, QA, data engineers, and business stakeholders to support timely delivery of product increments. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Possesses curiosity to ask the hard questions, explores new ideas, and continuously learns and researches to meet goals. Strong communicator & Influencer Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform complex data analysis. Possesses a “get-it-done” attitude – ability to get around roadblocks and stay focused on the vision. Organized, resourceful, and able to prioritize tasks. Has an interest in constantly learning new tools and technologies and a passion to share your knowledge with the team. Demonstrated interest in data products, including an understanding of data lineage, governance, integration patterns and data organization structures. Experience working in an agile environment. Experience working with AI, SQL and data products Bachelor's degree in business management or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 3-5 years product experience, 5-10 years of financial services experience requirements, and working closely with development team to ensure the successful delivery of the product.

title: Senior Vice President, Information Security
jobDescription: We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Information Security to join our Cyber Security – Identity and Access Management team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Executive title with hands-on technical leadership. You will architect, code, and lead delivery of enterprise-scale IAM platforms and services. Own end-to-end solutions across authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle, and security posture. Partner with senior stakeholders to align technology strategy with business outcomes while mentoring engineers and driving best-in-class engineering practices. Lead full-stack delivery of secure, resilient IAM capabilities (authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle) across enterprise applications. Set technical direction for Java/Spring-based services and web apps; enforce standards for reliability, performance, and security. Raise the bar on security (MFA, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP/AD integrations, API security, authorization models) and operational excellence. Reduce incidents via robust observability, disciplined incident/problem management, and root-cause remediation. Accelerate delivery through Git-based CI/CD, automated testing, and repeatable release processes. Mentor and grow engineering talent, foster ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Communicate architecture and trade-offs to senior leadership; align investments to measurable outcomes. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Education/Experience: Bachelor’s in computer engineering (or equivalent); 15+ years in enterprise software; 5+ years leading teams/serving as tech lead. Architecture & Design: Proven ability to design scalable, secure, highly available systems; clear documentation; lead design reviews and decision-making. Engineering Stack: Java/J2EE, Spring (Boot/Core), Spring Security; Angular/Type Script for front end with migration from legacy JSP to modern Angular; strong REST API design, versioning, testing, and governance; integration with enterprise identity providers. Identity & Access: LDAP, Site Minder, Active Directory; authentication/authorization models; MFA design and implementation; SSO and federation fundamentals. Security: Web app security, API security, OAuth2/Open ID Connect, token flows, secure session management, threat modeling, and secure coding practices. Data & Persistence: Oracle (or similar DBMS); schema design, SQL optimization, transaction integrity, and performance tuning. Dev Ops & Delivery: Git-based CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment promotion, release readiness, secrets/config management. Reliability & Operations: Troubleshooting, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis; application debugging; performance profiling and optimization; observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and auditability. Leadership & Communication: Hands-on ownership, stakeholder management, clear communication of architecture/trade-offs to senior leadership; ability to mentor and coach engineers; strong interpersonal skills. Experience with enterprise web app security reviews and threat modeling. Familiarity with authorization frameworks (RBAC/ABAC) and policy-as-code. Exposure to SSO, identity federation, and integrating with enterprise Id Ps. 50–70% individual contribution (design, coding, reviews); remainder spent on technical leadership and stakeholder alignment. Own critical decisions, operational readiness, and measurable reliability/security outcomes.

title: Senior Vice President, Data Science Manager
jobDescription: Senior Vice President, Data Science Manager We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Data Science Manager to join our Markets team. This role is located in Pune. In This Role, You’ll Make an Impact in the following ways This role enables production-grade, governed AI capabilities for Markets by designing, validating, and operating AI agents across their full lifecycle. The individual will own prompt engineering, model selection, RAG/KAG architectures, and ongoing model governance, ensuring AI solutions are explainable, stable, and compliant with DURB and MRMG expectations. Excellent knowledge of FX and Fixed Income products pricing, yield curve construction, scenario analysis, sensitivities calculations, PFE, Va R, and CCAR stress scenarios. Pricing model development and OPM review for Rates, FX, and Equity models. Work with desk strats and quantitative analytics teams to develop, maintain, and support C++/Python analytics libraries used for pricing and risk analytics. Define agent logic, behavior, and boundaries for Markets use cases across risk, trading, credit, surveillance, and analytics. Design stable, testable, and explainable prompts, with versioning and regression testing. Select, justify, and document AI/ML models appropriate to use case criticality and risk tier. Design AI architectures, including: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Knowledge Augmented Generation (KAG) Agent-to-agent communication patterns MCP-style server architectures for tool orchestration and control Establish validation and testing strategies so outputs are consistent, trusted, and auditable. Ensure AI agents remain assistive, bounded, and compliant over time. Produce MRMG / DURB-ready artefacts such as methodology, data lineage, controls, and fallback plans in parallel with development. Monitor model and agent behavior in production, including drift, instability, and control breaches. Continuously tune prompts, retrieval logic, and models as: New datasets are onboarded Market conditions shift Risk and regulatory expectations evolve Own ongoing performance monitoring (OPM) and respond to governance reviews, findings, and control enhancements. Hands-on experience supporting DURB and MRMG approvals. Ability to translate technical designs into governance-ready documentation. Strong understanding of: Model risk management Explainability and auditability MNPI, information barriers, and fiduciary risk Comfortable operating under regulatory scrutiny and evolving control frameworks. Strong Markets domain awareness across products, workflows, and risk sensitivities. Ability to partner with Front Office, Risk, Technology, and Governance stakeholders. Capable of balancing delivery speed with control rigor. Understands that AI in Markets does not self-govern; prompt quality, model choice, architecture, and validation directly impact market integrity, risk outcomes, and regulatory posture. Ensures AI remains trusted, controlled, and scalable as adoption grows. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and experience required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 16+ years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, or a related field. Proficiency in statistical programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and deliver actionable insights. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong understanding of model strengths, limitations, and failure modes. Model versioning, prompt versioning, and experiment tracking. Strong in XGBoost / Gradient Boosting Logistic Regression Linear Regression Time series models Clustering (k-means, hierarchical, DBSCAN) Dimensionality reduction (PCA, embeddings) Transformer-based models Large Language Models (LLMs) Embedding models for semantic search RAG KAG Semantic search Vector databases Agent orchestration Agent-to-agent communication Tool calling and decision gating MCP-style server architectures for secure tool access, observability, and control

jobDescription:

This role is located in Pune In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Demonstrates extensive knowledge of regulatory reporting best practices and understanding of Basel rules and regulatory reports Having relevant experience in Regulatory capital calculations with fair understanding of CET1, Tier1 and other capital components, Leverage exposure and Supplementary Leverage ratio. title: Senior Vice President, Treasury and ALM
jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President– Treasury to join our Treasury Team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Manages a large team (or multiple small teams) of professional staff responsible for asset/liability management, liquidity funding, capital management, ALM committee support, interest rate risk management and measurement for an assigned risk or asset category and/or across a business unit/legal entity. Contributes to the development of the operational framework for assigned area and develops approaches to achieve desired goals while balancing risk and ensuring regulatory compliance. May lead a discrete specialty within Treasury (e.g. Intraday Liquidity, Currency Risk, etc.) Manages the collection, validation and analyses of financial data underpinning the Bank's asset-liability model(s), liquidity funding model(s), capital management framework and/or currency and interest rate risks for assigned area. As part of a management team, monitors risks inherent in new or changing Bank products and implements adjustments to technical processes as needed. Monitors industry developments and applies best practices in order to establish policies and procedures that support the ALM, liquidity, capital management, interest rate risk and/or currency risk strategies for the assigned entity(ies) and balance regulatory requirements. Establishes team policies and procedures related to all technical activities such as documentation requirements, underlying assumptions, data limitations, etc. Develops reports and briefings for senior management, highlighting operational activities/outcomes, identifying risks and recommending proposed solutions. Ensures recommendations align to the corporate Treasury strategies and the strategies of the assigned entity(ies). Builds and cultivates relationships with internal peers in Treasury and Finance and externally with rating agencies, regulators, investors and domestic and international financial institutions. Recruits, directs, motivates and develops staff, maximizing their individual contribution, their professional growth and their ability to function effectively with their colleagues as a team. Provides feedback at the most critical times. Manages a large team or multiple small teams of professional staff. Responsible for a large team or multiple small teams' achievement of team objectives. Modified based upon local regulations/requirements. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Degree in math, engineering, statistics, computational finance or economics preferred. MBA, CFA, or CPA/CA preferred. 10-12 years of total work experience, with 1-3 years of management experience, preferred. Experience with liquidity stress testing, liquidity risk management, interest rate risk management, and/or asset-liability management within large complex financial organizations preferred. title: Director, Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Full stack Engineering to join our Risk team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: The Director, Full stack Engineering – Model Risk Management will be a member of the Engineering Practice and aligned to the Risk & Compliance Hub. This role is responsible for engineering strategy, architecture, and delivery for the Model Risk Management domain, with a focus on scalable platforms, strong controls, agile execution, and an AI-first approach to engineering outcomes. Design architectures to support model risk management, model validation, and ongoing monitoring processes. Codify and automate quantitative techniques used in model validation, controls testing, and governance workflows. Lead small, agile engineering teams focused on scalable and well-controlled model risk solutions. Drive an AI-first approach to automate and enhance model risk management frameworks, workflows, and decision support. Collaborate with stakeholders across risk, modeling, compliance, and technology teams to define priorities and deliver outcomes. Ensure engineering solutions are resilient, auditable, and aligned to enterprise architecture, control, and data standards. Support the evolution of model risk capabilities through strong technical leadership, disciplined execution, and stakeholder partnership. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. Experience with model risk management, model validation processes, and quantitative techniques in enterprise environments. Familiarity with agile practices and a track record of leading high-performing teams Operate as a senior engineering leader within the Engineering Practice, contributing to engineering standards, talent development, and platform-wide execution discipline. Work within the Risk & Compliance Hub to align delivery with hub priorities, regulatory expectations, and enterprise risk and control objectives. Lead small, high-performing agile teams using iterative delivery practices, transparent prioritization, and measurable outcomes. Partner closely with product, data, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to shape roadmaps and deliver resilient solutions. Promote an AI-first mindset by identifying opportunities to improve engineering productivity, automation, controls, and decision support. Create clarity on priorities, architecture direction, and execution outcomes for the team and stakeholders. Build strong engineering culture through coaching, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Balance innovation with sound engineering practices, operational resilience, and risk management. Represent the domain effectively across hub, practice, and enterprise governance forums. Drive delivery against strategic objectives while maintaining high standards for quality, performance, and control. title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobDescription: We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Full-Stack Engineer to join our BNY team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Design and develop scalable, high-performance full stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular Build RESTful APIs and microservices architectures Develop responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using Angular and modern frontend frameworks Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices Design and deploy applications in either BNY private cloud or public cloud Implement CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment Optimize application performance and scalability in cloud environments To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Backend: 8+ years of Java development experience with strong expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Spring Security Frontend: 4+ years of Angular development, Type Script, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) OR private cloud Databases: Proficiency in relational databases e.g. Postgre SQL, My SQL, Oracle Microservices architecture and design patterns Containerization e.g. Docker, Kubernetes Message queuing systems e.g. Kafka, Rabbit MQ Unit testing frameworks e.g. JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, Karma Agile/Scrum methodologies API Development: Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs Version Control: Git, Git Hub/Git Lab/Bitbucket Build Tools: Maven, Gradle, npm, webpack

title: Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobDescription:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President to join our Financial Management and Analysis team within the Office of the CFO team. This role is located in Pune In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: Lead management accounting activities, including internal reporting, expense analysis, and support for planning and forecasting processes. Oversee the preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting for senior finance leadership. Support in analyzing the key financial results, identifying key performance drivers, and provide clear variance commentary and actionable insights. Manage enterprise expense reporting and allocation activities to support consistent financial transparency across the organization. Partner with controllership, business finance, and other stakeholders to align reporting outputs and analytical approaches. Drive transformation, process improvement, simplification, standardization, and automation across reporting and management accounting activities. Use AI-enabled tools and advanced analytics to enhance reporting, identify trends, improve forecasting support, and strengthen management insights. Promote responsible use of AI and data-driven solutions within Finance processes, in alignment with governance and control expectations. Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support strategic initiatives, executive requests, and ad hoc financial analysis as required. Ensure all deliverables meet applicable governance, control, and data quality expectations. Leadership Competencies Strategic leadership Executive presence People leadership and talent development Stakeholder management and influence Accountability and ownership Collaboration across teams Change leadership Sound judgment and decision support Technical Competencies Management accounting Financial planning and analysis Financial reporting Expense and allocation analysis Forecasting and variance analysis Financial controls and governance Data analysis and insight generation Process improvement and automation What Success Looks Like Delivers timely, accurate, and decision-useful management reports. Provides strong financial insight to support senior leadership decision-making. Builds effective partnerships across Finance and business teams. Improves reporting efficiency, consistency, and transparency. Uses AI and automation thoughtfully to enhance productivity and analytical quality. Maintains a strong control and governance mindset. Develops and leads a high-performing team. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant advanced degree or certification. Significant experience in management accounting, FP&A, or related Finance function. Strong working knowledge on IBM Planning and Analytics tool Demonstrated experience leading teams and managing priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment. Strong financial analysis, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong stakeholder management and partnership skills. Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial analysis tools. Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics to improve reporting, analysis, or decision-making processes. Strong understanding of how to apply AI responsibly within a controlled Finance environment, including awareness of data quality, governance, and risk considerations. title: Director, Product Design
jobDescription:
Director, Product Design We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Product Design to join our Digital Channels team. This role is located in Pune. In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways: The experienced Design Director will lead and shape the design vision, strategy, and execution of one of our most critical spaces within BNY. This role will be pivotal in defining user experiences that deliver exceptional value to clients, driving user-centered designs, and pushing for elegant design solutions to highly complex problems. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in UX design, user research, and system thinking, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams. Design Leadership & Strategy: Serve as the primary UX and design subject matter expert for our product, influencing design direction and decisions. Develop and implement design strategies that align with the firm's business goals, ensuring design excellence in all of our deliverables. Lead and mentor other designers, fostering growth and professional development. User Research & Insights: Guide the execution of comprehensive user research, including surveys, interviews, and heuristic evaluations. Define and review user personas and translate research findings into actionable insights. Advocate for integrating user feedback and insights to continuously improve user experiences. Interaction & Information Design: Drive the creation of elegant workflows and patterns that champion exceptional customer experiences. Oversee the creation of concepts, wireframes, storyboards, and prototypes to support product design goals. Visual/UI Design: Direct and implement engaging visual styles that drive the value of our products and show exceptional craftsmanship. Act as a custodian of user interface and visual design standards, ensuring an ever-increasing quality of design excellence. Design Systems & Standards: Contribute to and refine our design systems, guidelines, and standards to ensure scalability and efficiency. Provide thoughtful strategy and insights on how to work with a large-scale design system while maintaining product flexibility and creativity. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, product managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to align design initiatives with business and technical goals. Act as a design ambassador, promoting user-centered design principles and the importance of design in achieving business success. Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Act as a champion for user-centered design, providing guidance to teams outside the design team. Stay ahead of industry trends, continuously fine-tuning expertise in UX and design practices. Communication & Influence: Present design strategies, insights, and decisions to senior leadership, driving consensus and buy-in. Foster a culture of innovation and collaboration, inspiring teams to deliver their best work. A portfolio is required to be considered for this position This portfolio should demonstrate some or most of the expertise described above. While process is extremely important, a portfolio should demonstrate a high-quality end product that you’re proud of leading. A portfolio could include a Figma link that’s open to view access. To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following: Typically, a candidate at this level has 12+ years of experience and some previous experience in regulated/complex spaces like finance, health or insurance.
